name: Righteous Fire Regen Tank
summary: A self-immolating caster shell built around the Righteous Fire buff, which burns the caster for a percentage of maximum Life and Energy Shield every second as Fire damage while igniting nearby enemies. Because RF's self-damage scales directly with your own defensive pools, Life/ES investment doubles as damage investment — survival comes from out-resisting and out-regenerating that self-damage (fire resistance, flat life regeneration, leech) rather than from mitigating incoming hits.

signals.description: Righteous Fire (or Vaal Righteous Fire) socketed and enabled as a persistent buff is the archetype's entire identity — everything else follows from it.
RF's own self-damage scales with max Life, so RF builds run very large life pools instead of just 'more life is safer' — it's a direct damage stat here, not only a defensive one.
Overcapped fire resistance is a near-universal RF trait since it directly reduces the self-damage tick, not just incoming enemy fire.
A less common ES-based variant swaps the Life scaling for Energy Shield scaling — RF still deals damage off max ES under CI, so this is a recognizable sub-build rather than a different archetype.

scalingVectors.explanation: RF's self-damage-per-second scales directly off a percentage of your maximum Life (roughly 0.9% per second, i.e. base_nonlethal_fire_damage_%_of_maximum_life_taken_per_minute / 6000 in PoB's data) before mitigation, so building Life isn't just survivability — it's your own damage output against enemies standing in the RF radius.

RF also scales off maximum Energy Shield (roughly 0.7% per second, the ES counterpart of the same per-minute self-damage formula), so hybrid Life/ES gear — and the rarer CI/ES-based variant — still contributes directly to clear/boss damage, not just to defense.

scalingVectors.mechanic: Increased Burning Damage / Damage over Time multiplier / gem level
scalingVectors.explanation: Generic 'increased Burning Damage', 'increased Damage over Time', and gem level all multiply RF's tick the same way they would any other DoT skill — these are the actual damage levers once the Life/ES base is set.

Fire resistance mitigates RF's self-damage the same way it mitigates an enemy hit. Pushing past 75% (and overcapping further) is the single biggest 'more damage you can survive' lever this archetype has, since it reduces the tax on your regen budget rather than the DoT itself.

deadStats.reason: RF is cast once and left running as a permanent buff — attack and cast speed after activation do nothing for its damage.
Damage over time cannot critically strike by default (only the Perfect Agony keystone converts crit multiplier into a DoT multiplier), so plain crit investment on an RF-only build is dead.

deadStats.stat: Chance to Bleed / Poison and their supports
deadStats.reason: RF deals only Fire damage over time — bleed/poison chance has no target skill to apply to.

layers: Fire resistance (mitigates own RF tick and most incoming fire)
Flat and % increased life regeneration (must outpace RF's self-damage after mitigation)
Life/ES leech or on-hit life gain as a burst buffer
A high maximum Life pool that doubles as damage scaling
characteristicWeaknesses: Elemental ailments and off-fire damage types (cold/lightning/physical hits) aren't covered by the RF-specific mitigation stack and need their own investment.
Chaos damage bypasses fire resistance entirely and is a common one-shot vector for RF builds that neglect chaos resistance.
Regen-based sustain can be outpaced by burst self-damage sources (extra fire damage taken debuffs, degen stacking) even when steady-state math looks safe.

failureModes.symptom: Character slowly dies while standing still with RF active and no enemies nearby
failureModes.diagnosis: Fire resistance is under 75% or regen doesn't cover the post-mitigation RF tick at current max Life/ES.
failureModes.fix: Push fire resistance to/above 75% (overcap further if possible) before adding more Life; check flat regen and % increased regen sources.

failureModes.symptom: TotalDPS looks low despite a high character level and full life pool
failureModes.diagnosis: Missing 'increased Burning Damage' or 'increased Damage over Time' scaling — the Life/ES base is there but the multiplier layer is empty.
failureModes.fix: Add supports/tree nodes for Burning Damage and Damage over Time multiplier; Elemental Focus is usually a straight upgrade since RF's own ignite chance is not a relevant damage source.

failureModes.symptom: Character dies instantly to a single hit despite a large Life pool
failureModes.diagnosis: No hit-mitigation layer (armour/evasion/block) — RF's stat investment is built around DoT self-damage, not incoming hits, and can leave the build with a large but paper-thin Life pool against hits.
failureModes.fix: Add a hit-avoidance or reduction layer — armour, Molten Shell, Basalt Flask, or block — since RF's own stat investment doesn't protect against being hit.
